# literature: results imported from papers

Some results are taken from the literature instead of being proved here (for example an error bound). This test
does not check that they are true. It checks that each one records its citation, the exact form used and how
the source's conventions map to ours. It grants **assumed**, never proved, so every node that rests on it shows
it in its frontier.

<!-- tests:begin (generated by `dagtool readmes`; edit the test docstrings, not this table) -->
| Test | What it checks | A pass grants |
|---|---|---|
| [`literature/source_record`](source_record.py) | An imported result names its source, the exact form used, and its conventions. | Assumed, never proved. |
